name: Example: carrier cellular DAS, warehouse (completed example)

data.address: Example distribution warehouse, Arlington VA area (fictional)
data.code: Owner spec: carrier coverage, Common preset
data.next_step: Quarterly check of the booster alarms with the owner; the carriers' consent letters on file
data.notes:
Completed worked example (fictional building, people and companies): a carrier cellular DAS for AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile, finished and In service.
The walk before design found every carrier weak behind the 30 ft racking. T-Mobile's first rooftop donor was below the −95 dBm minimum; a second donor aimed at another T-Mobile site (azimuth 20°) reads −84 dBm with SINR 7 dB, so all three carriers ride one industrial booster.
Each carrier gave its express consent (47 CFR 20.21(c)) before the booster went on the air. Twelve panel antennas down the aisles.
Acceptance on 9/22 and 9/23 with the calibrated COMPASS XR at the centre of every square: AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile pass the Common target (RSRP −95 dBm, SINR 5 dB, 95%) in every square. A Pixel 8 on AT&T walked the aisles too; its readings are corrected against the COMPASS XR (Grid test, Walk: Phone correction). C-band (n77) isn't carried: out of the owner's scope.

AT&T.contact: AT&T DAS team (example), ref ATT-EX-0442: B2 consented

T-Mobile.contact: Rebroadcast Agreement signed (example), ref TMO-EX-1187: B71

log.detail: Example: carrier cellular DAS, warehouse (completed example)
Call with Ray Kim (facilities): handhelds and phones drop calls behind the racking; AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile wanted inside.
Walk before design with the COMPASS XR: every carrier weak behind the 30 ft racking; T-Mobile out in squares 13 and 18.
example-warehouse-floor-1.png (the owner's plan, 400 x 300 ft)
Rooftop donors: AT&T −78 dBm (B2), Verizon −88 dBm (B13), T-Mobile −97 dBm (B71, below the minimum). A second T-Mobile site at 20°: −84 dBm, SINR 7 dB: used.
Consent requests sent to AT&T and Verizon
Consent request (Rebroadcast Agreement with Exhibit A) sent to T-Mobile
checks.permit: building permit for the low-voltage work
request for quote to Sample Supply Co. (example), Example Wireless Distribution (example)
bom: the best split chosen (each line from its cheapest supplier)
AT&T consent: B2, ref ATT-EX-0442
checks.design_ok: the owner signed off the design
Verizon consent: B13
T-Mobile Rebroadcast Agreement countersigned: B71, ref TMO-EX-1187
checks.consent: every carrier has consented
Install done; PIM on the booster output and the three aisle trunks: all better than −150 dBc.
Acceptance walk: COMPASS XR report at the centre of every square, all three carriers at target.
Pixel 8 (AT&T) compared with the COMPASS XR at six spots on band 2: it reads 4 dB low. Phone walk of the aisles, corrected by that table.
Cellular acceptance report (example).pdf

mail.subject: Request for express consent (47 CFR 20.21(c)): Example distribution warehouse
mail.body:
Hello,

We plan to install an industrial signal booster (distributed antenna system) at the Example distribution warehouse to improve AT&T coverage inside the building. Under 47 CFR 20.21(c), an industrial booster may operate only with the carrier's express consent, so we ask for yours.

The attached letter has the location, bands, booster, gain, power and donor antenna details.

Jordan Lee
Sample RF Services (example)
703-555-0109
